name: Boycott / conflict complicity
description: Named in active boycott campaigns, or material involvement in an ongoing armed conflict or occupation.

name: Human rights
description: Documented human rights abuses not already covered by labor rights (e.g. surveillance of dissidents, complicity in state repression).

name: Labor rights
description: Forced labor, unsafe working conditions, union-busting, wage theft, exploitative supply-chain practices.

name: Environment
description: Significant pollution, deforestation, greenwashing found to be materially false, or major climate-related harm.

name: Animal welfare
description: Animal testing beyond legal requirement, factory-farming practices, documented cruelty in supply chain.

name: Corruption
description: Bribery, embezzlement, or other corrupt practices confirmed by investigation, conviction, or credible reporting.

name: Tax avoidance
description: Aggressive tax avoidance structures (e.g. profit shifting) beyond routine legal optimization.

name: Political influence
description: Lobbying or political donations directed at undermining regulation, human rights, or democratic process.

name: Data privacy
description: Confirmed misuse of user data, surveillance overreach, or major data-protection violations.

name: Anti-competitive practices
description: Confirmed antitrust violations, predatory pricing, or market-dominance abuse.

name: Financial misconduct
description: Fraud, mis-selling, improper fee/premium practices, or risk-control failures that harmed customers or investors — distinct from corruption (which implies bribery or self-dealing).
